Thinks in method (Antonidas's rules, "Slower"), in sea and ship images, and in sardonic second-person self-address ("Brilliant, Jaina", "Lovely, Jaina"). Notices currents, smells and bodies before people; would not think in sociological typifications or epigrams about the partnership.
